ds2000.description: Control your communications with the DS2000, a USB button box with 3 buttons and 2 RGB LEDs designed to mute/unmute, deafen/undeafen, and disconnect from channels in Discord.

control.title: Intuitive Control
control.description: Three programmable buttons to mute/unmute, deafen/undeafen, and disconnect from channels, ideal for streaming and virtual meetings.

leds.title: Customizable RGB LEDs
leds.description: Two RGB LEDs to indicate status or customize with colors according to your configuration.

usb.title: USB Plug-and-Play Connection
usb.description: Connect the DS2000 to your computer via USB and use it without complications on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

design.title: Compact Design
design.description: Ergonomic and portable size to integrate perfectly into your setup.

drivers.title: Drivers and Software
drivers.description: Download the drivers and configuration software to customize your DS2000.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, the DS2000 is designed to integrate with applications like Discord allowing you to control audio and connection functions.
faq.q2: Do I need to install drivers?
faq.a2: Yes, the DS2000 software contains the device drivers.
faq.q3: Can I use the DS2000 on Linux?
faq.a3: Yes, it is compatible with distributions like Ubuntu and Fedora using the driver software.
